core_obligations: Include both vertex and edge support proofs; the short product conclusion alone is insufficient
Retain the actual W^140/W^96/W^236 constants and the full sigma-syndetic definition

proof_roadmap: Use a finite branch-point stabilizer and split it into vertex-supported and edge-supported factors.
Find a full supported moiety and use a comeager conjugacy class to obtain bounded powers on it.
Use almost-disjoint moieties and conjugation to cover all vertex supports with W^140.
Run the arc moiety argument for the edge factor with W^96.
Combine to get an identity neighborhood in W^236 and retain the automatic-continuity corollary.

The complete local core and236 bound are supplied; the resulting automatic-continuity corollary is not separately counted.
